index.title: Failed Jobs
index.subtitle: Queued jobs that exhausted their attempts — inspect, retry or clean up

labels.no-results: No failed jobs — the queue is healthy.

messages.retry-warning: Retrying re-queues this job for another execution attempt. It may repeat the job's side effects — verify the original operation before retrying jobs involving payments, orders, inventory, or external services.
messages.forget-warning: This permanently deletes the failed job record. This cannot be undone.
